status: Source-backed proposal only; no production edits in this phase

findings.problem: QFileInfo canonical paths can preserve junction aliases. Once Git deletes the target, resolving the alias fails and lexical comparison cannot identify affected persisted chats.
findings.fix_by_parent: Store Windows-final-handle canonical paths on connect; capture affected chat IDs before removal, detach those IDs after success, including old persisted aliases.

findings.problem: Native single-workspace chats erase the previous workspace association when reconnecting. Session load success is not proof that old worktree usage is known.
findings.fix_by_parent: Keep cleanup usageKnown=false until sufficient persisted usage accounting is available.

findings.problem: Switching to a chat without a workspace retained the previous file model/root. Empty rootPath would expose the Computer root rather than an empty workspace.
findings.fix_by_parent: Detach the file model for empty-workspace chats, restore it on a valid connect/select.

coverage: real linked worktree and junction aliases
archived/surviving chat detach and message preservation
actual PowerShell setup after successful persisted mount
other chat's busy local-fixture agent veto

verified_usage_source_correction.important: The upstream implementation is not a dedicated historical usage journal. A journal is a proposed native adaptation.
verified_usage_source_correction.query: packages/agent-core/src/services/agent-persistence/db.ts:629 queries every root-chat agent row for lastMessageAt and mountedWorkspaces[].
verified_usage_source_correction.aggregation: db.ts:71 collectWorkspaceLastUsedAtByPath matches requested worktree paths against raw and realpath-resolved stored mount paths, then takes the maximum lastMessageAt.
verified_usage_source_correction.native_difference: Native Conversation currently has one replaced workspace string. Upstream supports multiple persisted mounts. This prevents assuming equivalent coverage from native current workspace plus session.updated alone.

proposed_work.name: Per-repository worktree settings pane
contract: Horizontal repository chooser with managed-worktree count
Shell (.sh) and PowerShell (.ps1) tabs, Windows defaults PowerShell
Existing script content or source template; separate draft per variant
Reset and Save enabled only for dirty draft; Ctrl+S
Display script path, Codex setup fallback notice and copyable environment-variable names
Search managed worktrees; display branch, clean/current/removable reason and relative last use
Deletion through Settings policy only: managed, unmounted, attached and clean; branch retained
proposed_work.native_plan: New WorktreeSettingsPane QWidget consuming existing GitService setupRepositories/saveSetupScript/removeWorktree(Settings) APIs. Replace the global worktrees.setupScript placeholder only after repository selection and real file persistence are wired. Preserve unsaved drafts across refresh; reject external-script conflicts rather than silently overwrite.
proposed_work.host_boundary: Share the host mutation guard and start/finish tracking with GitPanel so Settings deletion also respects running agents, terminals and setups. Do not bypass the host guard by calling the bare service from a widget.
tests: two repositories and two variants do not exchange drafts
late list/save result cannot replace newly selected repo
failed/conflicting save retains draft and existing bytes
read-only/oversize/corrupt script failures visible
mounted/dirty/detached/unmanaged removal disabled and freshly rechecked
template reset, Ctrl+S and variable copy

proposed_work.name: Complete usage accounting and cleanup prompt
contract: Startup scan proposes clean unmounted attached managed worktrees unused at least seven days and merged into a permitted local branch
Never remove automatically; show candidate branch, merged target, path and last-use age
Don't Clean persists per-path dismissal for seven days
Prune snoozes when candidate disappears or snooze expires
Batch cleanup rechecks each candidate immediately before Git removal and reports partial failures
proposed_work.native_plan: Either implement upstream multi-mount persistence, or add a versioned canonical-path usage journal as a conservative adaptation. Record successful connect/selection/activity independently of current-chat workspace; use QSaveFile, QLockFile, validation and external-change detection. Keep usageKnown=false on corrupt/incomplete storage. For migration without prior history, conservatively mark existing managed paths recently used instead of inferring they were never used. Store per-path dismissedAt and prune only after a successful scan.
tests: reconnect does not erase previous use
restart retains use and snooze
corrupt/external-change storage disables cleanup and is not overwritten
seven-day boundary with injected clock
mounted/setup/dirty state changes after prompt block removal
partial success does not delete branches or unrelated paths
journal unknown state cannot become a destructive candidate

proposed_work.name: Shared event-driven worktree metadata watcher
contract: One watcher per commonGitDir with mounted-workspace reference counts
Allow only commonGitDir root, root HEAD, worktrees directory, worktrees/<name> directories and their HEAD files
Ignore objects, refs, logs, index and deeper churn
Detect root/linked branch switches, detach, external worktree add/remove and atomic HEAD replacement
400ms debounce; release final reference and pending timer on teardown
proposed_work.native_plan: New GitRepositoryWatcher using QFileSystemWatcher for the allowlist. Rebuild subscriptions when topology or atomic replacement changes watched paths. Since directoryChanged does not report individual children, compare bounded HEAD/topology fingerprints before emitting changes to avoid index-churn refresh storms. Share by canonical commonGitDir. Use visible-panel polling only when watcher coverage fails, and retain explicit branch/remote refresh for events outside this upstream topology contract.
tests: external worktree add/remove
main and linked checkout/detach
HEAD.lock atomic rename reattaches watcher
index/objects/log churn does not emit topology changes
multiple mounts share watcher and last release stops notifications
failed watches fall back visibly without tight polling
